title: Understanding the Remainder Theorem
text:
The Remainder Theorem: When $p(x)$ is divided by $(x - a)$, the remainder equals $p(a)$.

This is related to the Factor Theorem - if the remainder is 0, then $(x-a)$ is a factor.

title: Finding the Value of a
text:
The divisor is $(x - 3)$, which is in the form $(x - a)$.

Comparing: $x - 3 = x - a$

Therefore: $a = 3$

title: The Value to Substitute
text: We need to substitute $x = 3$ into the polynomial to find the remainder.
